text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it downgraded its rating on ICG Communications Inc to market performer for the intermediate six months from outperform.
-- It also lowered its EBITDA projections for calendar 1997 to a loss of about $120 million compared with its previous estimate of a loss of $60 million.
-- "Our calendar 1998 estimate is now a loss of $60 million compared with our previous estimate of positive $10 million," analyst W. Todd Scott said in a report.
-- "While ICG is on track to start capturing market share in the first quarter of 1997, its SG&A costs are going to almost double from their current levels during that period," Scott added.
-- ICG, which provides telecommunications services, was trading at 14-3/4, off 2-3/8.
